title: KubeCon EU 2026 - Travel & Expense Admin (scratchpad)
content:
Quick scratchpad for travel/admin + expense reminders for KubeCon EU 2026. Use this to capture action items, vendor contacts, and quick reimbursement notes. NOT a finalized itinerary - informal notes.

Top priorities (before travel):
- Confirm hotel block + rooming list (deadline: 2026-03-10) - add any late changes to the sheet.
- Submit pre-approval for any vendor meals > $100.
- Ensure attendees have valid visas / ETAs (list below).
- Badge pickup: onsite pickup recommended; bring photo ID and company badge/email confirmation.

Expense process reminders:
- Policy: submit expenses in Concur within 10 business days of travel end. Attach digital receipts for all items > $25.
- Per diem: follow EU per diem policy (meals only) - use code EXP-TRAVEL-PERD.
- Taxi/ride-hail: include start/end addresses + short reason.
- Meals with customers: tag with customer name and include attendee list. Use project code: PROJ-KC2026 or client-specific code if provided.
- Shared booth expenses: tag under cost center EVENTS-OPS and include invoice number from booth vendor.

Common expense categories (examples for quick copy/paste into Concur):
- Flight (air) - economy/business: EXP-TRAVEL-AIR | booking ref: ABC123 (update per traveler)
- Hotel - nights + folio: EXP-TRAVEL-HOTEL | vendor folio required for reimbursement
- Ground transport - taxi/uber: EXP-TRAVEL-GROUND | attach receipt
- Meals - per diem or receipt: EXP-TRAVEL-MEAL | list attendees for >1 person
- Shipping - booth materials: EXP-TRAVEL-SHIPPING | vendor invoice (ShipFast EU)

Vendor & contact quicklist:
- Hotel block: Hotel Europa (group manager: Marta Kovacs) - marta.kovacs@hoteuropa.eu | +36 1 234 5678 | Block code: REDWOOD-KC2026
- Booth shipping: ShipFast EU - esther@shipfasteu.com | +44 20 7946 0123 | Account: Redwood-Inference
- Local AV / Booth tech: EuropaAV - av-support@europaav.com | onsite contact: Tomasz (mobile +48 600 111 222)
- Travel agency (bookings & changes): Redwood Travel Desk - travel-desk@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0199 (internal team handles group changes)
- Visa/immigration help: Global Visas Ltd. - visas@globalvisas.co.uk | ticket REF GV-9987 (if needed)

Packing / logistics checklist (personal + booth):
- Badge confirmation email (print or screenshot)
- Laptop + chargers + USB-C dongle
- Chargers for other devices, power strip for booth
- Business cards and sponsor swag (count + pack list)
- Booth signage + Velcro / zip ties / extension cords (confirm with ShipFast manifest)

Onsite schedule notes (draft):
- Day 0 (setup): booth arrival 08:00 - AV check at 09:30 - crates to storage by 17:00
- Day 1-3: booth duty shifts (TBD) - ensure we have 2 reps / peak hours 11:00-15:00
- Speaker prep: Sam Lee 12:00 rehearsal at Speaker room B (confirm AV laptop connectors)

Action items (who/what):
- Jordan: finalize rooming list + upload to travel sheet (due 2026-03-06)
- Alex: coordinate ShipFast pickup + confirm crate manifest (due 2026-03-08)
- Samantha: confirm speaker AV requirements and upload slides to conference portal (due 2026-03-07)
- Olivia: collect receipts from team leads after travel and submit consolidated expense bundle to Concur (target submission 2026-03-18)

Notes / loose thoughts:
- Consider pre-purchasing local SIMs if multiple team members need data; otherwise rely on hotel wifi.
- If anyone upgrades flights and wants company to cover difference, pre-approval MUST be logged in Concur (expensing policy).
- Keep booth electronics inventory sheet in shared drive (link above) and take photos of crate contents before shipping.

Receipts / sample wording for misc reimbursements to speed approvals:
- "Lunch with potential partner (Acme Corp) - 2026-03-15 - attendees: Olivia Park, Jordan Kim - purpose: intro meeting - PROJ-KC2026"

Useful links / refs copied here:
- Conference badge portal: https://events.kubeconeu.com/attendee (replace with actual link from confirmation email)
- Redwood events Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/987654321/KubeCon+EU+2026

Keep adding quick notes here. This doc will be the single-source scratchpad for admin items until we move everything to the Events Confluence page and the travel sheet.

---
Last quick checklist before submitting expenses: receipts attached, folio for hotel, invoice for shipping, attendee lists for shared meals, project/cost center codes included.
